records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うーん…
records.current_English: Hmm...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: どうした、FI？
records.current_English: What is it, FI?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あ、クラウ
この２つの石版って、きっと
地図なんだよね？
records.current_English:
Clau, these two tablets
 make up a map, right?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
あ？　何言ってんだ？
そりゃそうだろう
records.current_English:
What are you talking about?
 Of course they do.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
『謎の石版上部』、『謎の石版下部』
どっちを見ても、『証』がどこだか
見当もつかないんだ
records.current_English:
I looked at the Upper Stone Tablet 
 and the Lower Stone Tablet. I still
 have no idea where the Proof is.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
『謎の石版上部』、『謎の石版下部』
ですね。しかし、これでは『証』が
どこだかさっぱり分かりませんよ
records.current_English:
The Upper Stone Tablet 
 and the Lower Stone Tablet,
 yes. Still, I can't tell 
 where the Proof is from these.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
何やってんだよ？
２つを別々に見たら
全然分かんねえのは当然だろが
records.current_English:
What are you doing? Of course
 they don't make sense if you look
 at them one at a time!

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
２つをバラバラに見ているから
分かりにくいのではないですか？
records.current_English:
Could it be because we're
 looking at them separately?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そっか！
ちゃんと並べてみよう
上部ってことは、これを上にして…
records.current_English:
You're right! Let's put them 
 together. This is the upper half,
 so it goes here...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: で、もう１つの石版を下に置くのか？
records.current_English: And the other one goes below it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん。こうやって置くと…
records.current_English: Right. If we put them like this...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ぴったりだね！
…あ、あれ！？
records.current_English: They fit perfectly! Wait, what?!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
あ、２つの石版がぴったりと
組み合わさっていきますよ！
records.current_English:
Look! The two tablets
 are joining together!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おお、こりゃすげえ！
records.current_English: Whoa! Amazing!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
２つの石版がくっついて
１つになっちゃった…
records.current_English: The two pieces fused into one...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おい！
何かの印があるみてえだ！
さっきまで、こんなのはなかったぞ
records.current_English:
Hey! Looks like there's a mark 
 here! That wasn't there before.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
あれ？
これ、何かの印に見えませんか？
こんなの、最初からあったかな…？
records.current_English:
Wait. Doesn't this look like 
 some kind of mark? 
 Was that there before?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: えっ、本当？
records.current_English: Really?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そうか！
この印が指し示してる場所に
アフリカの『覇者の証』があるんだ！
records.current_English:
That's it! This mark shows where 
 to find Africa's Proof of Conquest!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
も、もしかして！
これが『覇者の証』の位置では
ないでしょうか？
records.current_English:
C-could this show us 
 where the Proof is?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: す、すげえ！
records.current_English: Th-that's amazing!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: よし、すぐに出発しなきゃな！
records.current_English: All right, let's get going!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
さっそく探しに行きましょうよ
FI、クラウ！
records.current_English:
Come on, FI, Clau!
 Let's go find it!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん、行こう！
records.current_English: Yeah, let's go!

groups.earlier_scene_context: Alternative participants propose arranging two tablet halves;the artifacts join andreveal a location. Conditional alternatives are not simultaneous participants. Rafael’s certainty andthe other speaker’s tentative inference differ.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
…
FU君だね
records.current_English: ...FU, isn't it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: あなたは？
records.current_English: Who might you be?

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
申し遅れたね。私はバスラを本拠に
商いなどを少々営んでいる者
名はアブラハン・イブン・ウッディーン
という
records.current_English:
Forgive me. I do a little business 
 out of Basra. My name
 is Abraham Ibn Uddin.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ど、どうも
records.current_English: Oh. P-pleased to meet you.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
FOの噂を
ひんぱんに聞くようになって
しばらくになる
なかなか手広くやってるようだね
records.current_English:
I've been hearing a great deal 
 about FO
 for some time. You seem to be doing
 quite a bit of business.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: いえ、そんな…
records.current_English: Oh, I wouldn't say that...

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
ちょっと相談があるんだが
いいかな？
records.current_English:
There's something I'd like 
 to discuss with you. 
 Do you have a moment?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
（物静かだけど威厳のある人だな…
　よし、ここは…）
records.current_English:
(He's quiet, but there's 
 something commanding about him.
 All right...)

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: 断るわけにはいかないだろうな
records.current_English: I can hardly refuse...

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: どこか怖そうな人だ。やめておこう
records.current_English: He's rather intimidating. Better not.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
少し先まで
ご足労願うことになるんだが
records.current_English:
I'm afraid I'll have to ask
 you to come a little farther.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: は、はい。お供します
records.current_English:
Y-yes, of course.
 I'll come with you.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese: では、バスラのギルドで落ち合おう
records.current_English: Let us meet at the Guild in Basra.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
分かりました
バスラのギルドですね
records.current_English: The Guild in Basra. Understood.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
そうだ
先に行って待っている
records.current_English:
That's right. I shall go ahead 
 and wait for you.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
はい
では後ほど
records.current_English: All right. Until then.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese: では
records.current_English: Until then.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
すみません。一度仲間に相談してきます
提督の独断というわけには
いきません
records.current_English:
I'm sorry, but I should
 speak to my crew first.
 I can't make a decision like 
 this on my own.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
君の判断を聞きたかったんだが
…いや、すまなかったね
いつかどこかで
会うことになるだろう。それでは
records.current_English:
I was hoping to hear what you
 thought. Well, forgive me. I expect
 we'll meet again someday. Goodbye.

groups.earlier_scene_context: A quiet,dignified merchant requests Rafael’s personal judgment. Acceptance leads tomeeting atthe Basra Guild;refusal is politelyexplained asconsulting the crew. Inner-choice fear isRafael’s reaction,not objectivevillainy. FU remains distinct.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese: 決めてくれたかな
records.current_English: Have you decided?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
はい
いろいろと考えましたが…
records.current_English: Yes. I've thought it over...

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese: ふむ。聞かせてもらおう
records.current_English: Very well. What have you decided?

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: 同盟をお受けします
records.current_English: I accept the alliance.

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: やはり同盟は、承諾しかねます
records.current_English: I'm afraid I can't accept.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あなたを信頼します
これからよろしくお願いします
records.current_English:
I'm putting my trust in you. 
 I look forward to working together.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
そう言ってくれてうれしいよ。それでは
FA総帥
早速、商談に入りたいのだが
よろしいかな？
records.current_English:
I'm pleased, Mr. FA.
 Shall we talk business?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: は、はい。分かりました
records.current_English: Y-yes, of course.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
では、別室へ案内させよう
…
FA総帥を
応接室にお通ししてくれ
records.current_English:
Let's continue in another room.
 Please show Mr. FA
 to the reception room.

records.speaker: Ibn Niyadi
records.Japanese: かしこまりました
records.current_English: At once.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
まず、協定の内容だが
目標はザモリン・ナガルプル侯
インド周辺に勢力を持っている
records.current_English:
First, the purpose of our alliance.
 Our target is Lord 
 Zamorin Nagalpur, who holds power
 around India.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
金の亡者といった男でね
品位のない彼の強欲な商法のおかげで
我々は大いに迷惑している
records.current_English:
The man worships money.
 His grasping way of doing business 
 has caused us no end of trouble.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
彼が所有する商会の財力は大きく
その力は侮れないが、おせじにも
“人物”とは言いがたい男だ
records.current_English:
His company is wealthy,
 and that makes him dangerous.
 As for his character, there's
 very little to admire.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
我らが組めば
いずれ倒すことができよう
records.current_English:
Together, we should be able
 to defeat him in time.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: はい
records.current_English: Yes.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
そこでだ
君が不安になるところだとは思うが…
records.current_English: Now the part that may concern you...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ナガルプル商会を倒した後のことですね
records.current_English: What happens after Nagalpur falls?

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
その通り。さすがだね。協定自体は
そこで終了だ。契約の書面が
あるわけでもないのだが、あとは
『不可侵条約』に切り替えてもらいたい
records.current_English:
Exactly. You saw that coming.
 Our alliance ends there. We have 
 nothing in writing. I'd like 
 a nonaggression pact after that.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 不可侵…ですか
records.current_English: A nonaggression pact...?

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
私の本拠であるアラブ周辺においては
ある程度の比率で君の商会と共存
できよう。その他の都市、港は
君の自由裁量に任せる
records.current_English:
I'm based in Arabia. Our companies 
 can share those markets, 
 within reason. What you do in other
 cities and ports is up to you.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
アラブ圏に、あまり手を出すな
ということですね
records.current_English:
So you want us to limit how much 
 business we do in Arabia.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
そういうことだ
我々も決して君たちの邪魔はしないと
約束しよう
records.current_English:
That's right. And I give you my
 word we won't stand in your way.

records.speaker: System panel
records.Japanese:
ウッディーンにマスカットの
シェアを分けてもらいました
records.current_English:
Uddin gave you part of his 
 market share in Muscat.

records.speaker: System panel
records.Japanese:
ウッディーンにソコトラの
シェアを分けてもらいました
records.current_English:
Uddin gave you part of his 
 market share in Socotra.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
分かりました
他にありますか？
records.current_English: Understood. Anything else?

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
いや、それだけでいい
手間をとらせてすまなかった
records.current_English:
No, that's all.
 Thank you for coming to see me.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
こちらこそ
まだまだ小さな
FOですが
協力させていただきます
records.current_English:
The pleasure's mine. 
 FO is still 
 small, but you can count on us.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
ありがとう
期待しているよ
records.current_English: Thank you. I'm counting on you.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: では、ナガルプルを倒しましょう！
records.current_English: Then let's defeat Nagalpur!

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
うむ
互いに力を合わせ邁進しよう
records.current_English: Agreed. We'll move forward together.

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese: 同盟は受けない、と？
records.current_English: You decline?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 申し訳ありません…
records.current_English: My apologies...

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
アフリカの傷は癒えていない
というわけか
records.current_English:
Still smarting 
 from what happened in Africa, then?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: いえ、そういうことでは…
records.current_English: No, that isn't what I meant...

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese:
君ほどの者が判断したのだ。これよりは
敵同士、互いにインド洋の覇者を
めざそう。…というのは変かな？
records.current_English:
I respect your judgment. We'll 
 be rivals now, both after control
 of the Indian Ocean. An odd way
 to put it, isn't it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
は、はい
…お手柔らかに
records.current_English: Y-yes... Go easy on us, all right?

records.speaker: Abraham Uddin
records.Japanese: ではさらばだ
records.current_English: Farewell, then.

rows: from what happened in Africa, then?

groups.earlier_scene_context: Acceptance negotiates limited Arabian coexistence,freedom elsewhere,an anti-Nagalpur alliance anda later nonaggression pact. Refusal remains courteous rivalry;one conditional line references Africa. Preserve every offer/limitation andavoid inventing a written treaty already signed.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
気になっていたんだけど
この『枯れないハスの葉』って
『覇者の証』の地図なんだよね？
records.current_English:
I keep thinking about
 this Evergreen Lotus Leaf. It's
 a map to the Proof, right?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
あのウッディーンが言うんだから
間違いねえだろ
records.current_English: If Uddin says it is, it must be.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 何と組み合わせるのかなあ
records.current_English:
I wonder what we're supposed 
 to combine it with.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
この『クシャナ朝の大皿』は
どうでしょう？
records.current_English: How about this Kushan Platter?

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
この『クシャナ朝の大皿』は
どうでしょう？
records.current_English: How about this Kushan Platter?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
皿の上に葉を乗せてみようか
…何も起きないや
records.current_English:
Let's put the leaf on the platter
 and see... Nothing's happening.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おい、どうすりゃいいんだ？
records.current_English: Well, what do we do now?

rows: a map to the Proof, right?

groups.earlier_scene_context: The leaf andplatter are tried together without water,andnothing happens. Alternate speakers propose the same object. The nextcomplete exchange supplies the missing water step.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
この『古代王国の貨幣』
ずいぶん汚れてるね
records.current_English: This Ancient Kingdom Coin is filthy.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
んじゃ、ちょっと磨いてみるか？
そこに『乳液の入った壺』があるだろ
records.current_English:
Why don't we polish it a little? 
 There's a Lotion Jar right there.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
何なの、この液？
ま、いいか。やってみよう
液をつけて…
records.current_English:
What's in it? Oh, never mind.
 Let's try a little...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ごしごし
records.current_English: Rub, rub...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
！　お、おい、FI
調子に乗ってこすってないで
ちゃんと見ろよ！　溶けちゃってるぞ！
records.current_English:
H-hey, FI! Quit 
 rubbing and look at it!
 It's dissolving!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
わ、わ、いけない！
…あれ？
records.current_English: Oh no! ...Huh?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…別な模様が出てきたよ
地図みたいだけど…
records.current_English:
Wait, there's a different pattern
 coming through. Looks like a map...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
じゃ、東南アジアの『覇者の証』の
地図か！表面が溶けると、地図が
出てくるって仕組みだったんだ
records.current_English:
That's the map to Southeast Asia's 
 Proof of Conquest! The surface 
 had to dissolve first.

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese:
では、東南アジアの『覇者の証』の
地図！表面が溶けると、地図が顔を
出すようになっている…
records.current_English:
Then this is the map 
 to the Proof of Conquest in
 Southeast Asia! It's made to appear
 when the surface dissolves.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おっしゃ！
東南アジアの『覇者の証』の場所も
これで分かるぜ！
records.current_English:
All right! Now we know where 
 to find the Proof
 in Southeast Asia!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あーよかった
丸ごと溶けちゃわなくて…
records.current_English: Whew. Glad it didn't all dissolve...

rows: to the Proof of Conquest in
Southeast Asia! It's made to appear

groups.earlier_scene_context: A coin iscarelesslyrubbed withunidentified milkyfluid. Its surface dissolves,revealing a map,andRafael ends withrelief that thewholecoin survived. Do not identifythefluid asmilk,acid,soap ormedicine withoutbinding/source support.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
FIよう
この海域ってのは、スペインの
奴らに一歩先に行かれたって
感じだよな
records.current_English:
FI, Spain seems one step ahead 
 of us in these waters.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そうみたいだね
でも、まだ挽回するチャンスはある
はずだよね
records.current_English:
Looks that way. But we still 
 have a chance to catch up.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ああ。先に覇者の証さえ手に入れりゃ
一発逆転だ
records.current_English:
Yeah. Get the Proof first, 
 and we could turn the whole
 thing around.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
それに、何といっても、僕たちは
ポルトガルを復興しなくちゃ
いけないんだ。スペインにここを
譲るわけにはいかないよ！
records.current_English:
More than anything, we have to 
 restore Portugal. We can't 
 give up these waters to Spain!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ま、祖国復興を目指すおまえの
気持ちも分からねえわけじゃねえ
…やるしかねえよな
records.current_English:
Well, I get why you want to restore
 Portugal. We'd better
 get on with it, then.

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
あんた、スペインの人間じゃないね
もしかして
FOの人かい？
records.current_English:
You're not Spanish.
 Are you with FO?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: そうですが…
records.current_English: Yes, we are...

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
大きな声じゃ言えないんだが
ここいらはマルドナードの縄張りだ
ヤツの評判は知ってるかね？
records.current_English:
Keep your voice down.
 This is Maldonado's territory. 
 Do you know his reputation?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 評判？　よくない噂でもあるんですか？
records.current_English:
His reputation? Have you heard 
 anything bad about him?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
えーと、そもそも、その人を
よく知らないんですが…
records.current_English:
Well, I don't really know
 who he is to begin with...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 評判？　よくない噂でもあるんですか？
records.current_English:
His reputation? Have you heard 
 anything bad about him?

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
FOの
あんただから話すんだが、実は
ここいらの住民はみんなマルドナードを
憎んでいるんだ
records.current_English:
I'll tell you because you're 
 with FO, but keep 
 it quiet. Everyone around here 
 hates Maldonado.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
憎んでるって…穏やかじゃねえな
いったい、どういうヤツなんだ？
records.current_English:
That's strong talk. What kind
 of man are we dealing with?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
教えてください
どうして嫌われているんですか？
records.current_English:
Please, tell us. Why does everyone 
 hate him?

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
ヤツらはここいら一帯を力で支配し
スペイン王国の支配を後ろ盾にして
いいように振舞ってやがってな
records.current_English:
They rule the whole area by force. 
 With Spain's crown behind them,
 they do what they like.

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
あたりを通る商船を無差別に襲って
自分の懐をせっせと太らせてるんだ
records.current_English:
They attack any merchant ship
 that passes through, lining
 their own pockets.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: まるで、海賊みたいだな
records.current_English: Like a pirate...

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
ああ、その言葉がぴったりだ。これじゃ
船乗りたちも安心して海に出られや
しない。こっちの商売もあがったりさ
records.current_English:
That's exactly what they are.
 Sailors can't put to sea safely. 
 It's ruining my business too.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
…そんなに簡単に俺たちを信用して
いいのかい？　もしかしたら
俺らも似たようなもんかも
しれないんだぜ？
records.current_English:
Are you sure you want to trust us
 that fast? We could be just as bad,
 you know.

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
FOの噂は
聞いてるよ。少なくとも、あんたらは
住民を虐待するようなマネは
しないだろ？
records.current_English:
I've heard about FO before.
 At least you wouldn't mistreat 
 the people here, would you?

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: マルドナードを倒します！
records.current_English: We'll defeat Maldonado!

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: どうしよう…
records.current_English: What should we do...?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: FI…
records.current_English: FI...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…これ、新大陸全体で起こっている問題
なんじゃないかって気がする
マルドナードだけじゃなく
他の勢力も…
records.current_English:
I get the feeling this is happening
 all over the New World. It may be
 more than Maldonado and his men...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
だから、ヤツさえ倒せば解決するって
いうわけにはいかないんじゃ
ないかな。倒すにしても準備が
いるし…
records.current_English:
Beating him might not solve it.
 And even if we decide to fight him,
 we'd need time to prepare.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
おじさん、いろいろ考えると
僕たち、すぐには力になれそうに
ないんですが…
records.current_English:
Sir, after thinking it over, 
 I don't think
 we can help right away...

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese: そうかい…
records.current_English: Oh...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
とにかく、参考になったぜ
な、FI？
records.current_English:
Well, that was helpful.
 Right, FI?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん。地元の人が苦しんでる状況が
よく分かりました。近いうちに…
何とかしたいと思っています
records.current_English:
Yes. I see how much people here
 are suffering. I hope we can do
 something for them soon...

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
あんたたちがヤツらと
同じじゃないことを祈ってるよ…
records.current_English: I hope you aren't like those men...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…おじさんは僕たちを信用して
話してくれたんですよね
その信頼に応えるために…
records.current_English:
...You trusted us enough to tell 
 us all this. We ought to live up 
 to that trust...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
みんな！
僕たちでマルドナードを倒し
新大陸に平和をもたらそう！
records.current_English:
Everyone! Let's defeat Maldonado 
 and bring peace to the New World!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: へっ、やってやろうじゃねえか
records.current_English: Heh. Let's do it.

records.speaker: Barkeep
records.Japanese:
そうか、やってくれるか
楽しみに待ってるぜ
こんな暮らしもしばらくの辛抱だな…
records.current_English:
You'll do it? Good. I'll 
 be waiting. Maybe we won't have to 
 live like this much longer...

groups.earlier_scene_context: A resident reportsSpanish-backed predation byMaldonado. Rafael eitherreasons that a widerproblem needs preparation,orimmediatelycommits todefeat him. Preserve bothoutcomes,the resident’s qualified trust andhis hope. No ethnicidentity orfamilytie is asserted bygenericaddresses.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
FOってのが
最近このあたりに進出して
きたそうですね
records.current_English:
I hear some outfit called
 FO has moved into the area.

records.speaker: Juan Blanco
records.Japanese:
そうらしいな
かなり手ごわいという噂も聞く…
records.current_English:
So I hear. They say they're
 a tough lot to deal with.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
こりゃ、エスカンテ様の計画も
危ないんじゃないですか？
records.current_English:
Won't that put Governor Escante's
 plan in danger?

records.speaker: Juan Blanco
records.Japanese:
シッ！　その話を大きな声でするな！
エスカンテ様の配下でも、それを
知っている者はごくわずかなのだぞ！
records.current_English:
Shh! Keep your voice down! Only
 a handful of Governor Escante's own
 men know about that!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
へへっ、すいやせん
要はエスカンテ様にとって
じゃまな存在じゃねえかって
ことでして
records.current_English:
Heh. Sorry. I just meant they might
 get in Governor Escante's way.

records.speaker: Juan Blanco
records.Japanese: それはエスカンテ様が決めることだ
records.current_English:
That is for Governor Escante 
 to decide.

records.speaker: Juan Blanco
records.Japanese:
逆に、マルドナードに対抗するために
彼らを味方につけるという手もある…
records.current_English:
Or we could get them on our side 
 against Maldonado...

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
どのみち、エスカンテ様が新大陸を
支配し、本国からの…おっと、やべえ
records.current_English:
Either way, Governor Escante 
 will rule the New World. And then
 the homeland... Oops.

records.speaker: Juan Blanco
records.Japanese:
…命が惜しければ
おしゃべりはその辺にしておくことだ
records.current_English:
If you value your life, that's 
 enough talk.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
おっかねえ、おっかねえ
まあ、誰だってこの海域をそう簡単に
手放そうとはしませんやね
records.current_English:
All right, all right. Nobody's 
 going to give up these waters
 without a fight, anyway.

records.speaker: Juan Blanco
records.Japanese:
フッ
FOとかいう
連中がどこまでやるかは知らんがな
records.current_English:
Hmph. Time will tell 
 how far FO gets.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: へへっ、そうですね
records.current_English: Heh heh. Right.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
…FI？
今の話、聞こえましたよね…
records.current_English:
FI, you heard 
 that too, didn't you?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん。あれってメキシコ総督の
エスカンテって人の話だよね？
records.current_English:
Yes. They were talking about 
 Escante, the governor of Mexico, 
 weren't they?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: なんか、怪しいニオイがプンプンしたぜ
records.current_English: That stank of trouble.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 『計画』がどうとか言ってたね…
records.current_English: They mentioned a plan...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
じゃが、勢力を広げようとしているのは
どこも同じじゃぞ
records.current_English:
Who isn't trying to expand 
 these days?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
ええ、確かにそうですが
何やら『計画』だとかなんとか…
records.current_English:
True, but what did they mean 
 by 'the plan'?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うーん、確かに怪しい感じだけど
簡単に敵を増やすのもどうかと思うな
宣戦布告されたわけでもないし…
records.current_English:
It's suspicious, sure, 
 but we shouldn't rush to make more 
 enemies. They haven't declared war.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
なーにアマイこと言ってんだよ
ああいうことをほざく奴らなんだ
今のうちに手を打ったほうがいいって
records.current_English:
Don't be naive. You heard the way
 they talk. We ought to do something
 while we can.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
エスカンテの野郎が
新大陸全部を手に入れてから
泣いても遅いんだぜ
records.current_English:
Once Escante has the whole 
 New World, it'll be too late 
 to do anything about it!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そりゃ、スペインがもっと大きな力を
手に入れたら困るけど…
records.current_English:
I know. We can't have Spain
 getting any stronger, but...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: だったら決まりじゃねえか
records.current_English: Then what are we waiting for?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん…考えてみるよ
records.current_English: Yes... I'll think about it.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
奴らにとっても、僕らは目障りなんだな
新大陸を制覇するためには当然かも
しれないけど
records.current_English:
We're in their way too. I suppose
 that's bound to happen if they want
 the whole New World.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
じゃ、逆にいえば、俺たちには
エスカンテはじゃまってことかあ！
records.current_English: Well then, Escante's in our way too!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: クラウ…、キツイですね…
records.current_English: Clau... That's rather harsh.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
まあ、これも運命なのかもしれんな
戦うべきときは戦わねばならぬ
records.current_English:
Maybe it's fate. When
 the time comes to fight, 
 we have to fight.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…時には、敵を倒す力が必要に
なるときもあるんですよね…
records.current_English:
Sometimes you need the strength
 to defeat an enemy, don't you...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
エスカンテもマルドナードも
同じってことさ
早いうちに叩いておくに限るって
records.current_English:
Escante, Maldonado, they're all
 the same. Best to hit them early.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: これは、やるしかなさそうですね…
records.current_English: I don't see another way...

rows: So I hear. They say they're
a tough lot to deal with.
If you value your life, that's

groups.earlier_scene_context: Enemyunderlings nearlyreveal Escante’s secretplan. Keep the homeland sentenceunfinished ratherthan completing it fromlaterplot. Rafael’s caution andClaudio’s preemptive pragmatism differ;alternate lines move towardreluctantacceptance ofnecessaryforce.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ところで、エスカンテと
マルドナードって野郎はどういう
関係なんだ？
records.current_English:
So what's the story
 with Escante and Maldonado?
 Do they get along?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
どうって…同じ新大陸を治める者同士
うまくやってるんじゃないの？
records.current_English:
Well... They both rule parts 
 of the New World. They probably
 get along, don't they?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
じゃあ、もしもヤツらが
協力して俺らに向かってきたら
どうするよ？
records.current_English:
What if they join forces 
 and come at us?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うーん…そのときはそのときだよ
records.current_English:
Hmm... 
 We'll deal with that if it happens.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
FI！
ヤツらにとって
俺たちがじゃまなのは分かってるだろ！
このままじゃ、やられるぜ！
records.current_English:
FI, you know we're
 in their way! Keep this up 
 and they'll get us first!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
しっ！
クラウ、FI！
ちょっと、あれを見てください！
records.current_English: Shh! Clau, FI! Look over there!

records.speaker: Vasquez Maldonado
records.Japanese:
ちっ、エスカンテめ
おそらくヤツの狙いは…
records.current_English:
Damn Escante. What he's probably 
 after is...

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
間違いないでしょう！
エスカンテを信用してはなりません！
records.current_English:
I'm sure of it. We can't 
 trust Escante!

records.speaker: Vasquez Maldonado
records.Japanese:
まあ、待て
今エスカンテにケンカを売るわけにゃあ
いかんのだ
records.current_English:
Hold on. We can't afford to pick 
 a fight with Escante right now.

records.speaker: Vasquez Maldonado
records.Japanese:
ひとまず協力して他の勢力を叩きつつ
俺自身の縄張りを広げるのが第一よ！
records.current_English:
We'll work with him for now
 and take down the other factions.
 First thing is to expand 
 my own territory.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
確かに、今エスカンテと戦っても
勝ち目が…
records.current_English:
True. If we fought Escante now,
 we wouldn't stand much of a...

records.speaker: Vasquez Maldonado
records.Japanese:
みなまで言うんじゃねえ！
クソッ、腹が立つぜ
エスカンテの野郎め！
records.current_English:
Don't say it! Damn it, that bastard
 Escante makes my blood boil!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: 今の、マルドナードですよね？
records.current_English: That was Maldonado, wasn't it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
エスカンテとマルドナードが
仲いいってことはなさそうだな
records.current_English:
So much for Escante and Maldonado
 getting along.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: 利権争いですかね？
records.current_English: Fighting over trade rights, maybe?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
どっちもこの新大陸を独り占め
してえんだって
records.current_English:
They both want the New World 
 all to themselves.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
でも
『ひとまず協力して他の勢力を叩く』
って聞こえましたが…
records.current_English:
But he did say they'd
 work together for now to take down 
 the other factions...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
こりゃ、真っ先に狙われるのは
間違いなく俺たちだぜ
records.current_English: They'll come after us first.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: そうなのかな…
records.current_English: Do you think so...?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
彼らがポルトガルの私たちと組んでも
利益になりませんからね…
records.current_English:
They have nothing to gain
 from teaming up with a Portuguese
 company like ours...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 来るなら、戦うしかないか…
records.current_English:
If they come for us, we'll 
 have to fight...

rows: in their way! Keep this up

groups.earlier_scene_context: Rafael’s assumption that theSpanishrulers getalong isdisprovedbyan overheardargument. Their temporaryalliance nevertheless putsFO atrisk. Maldonado’s subordinate iscutoff beforeexplicitlyfinishing the admission ofweakness. Do not invent the secretgoal.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
この『儀式用の小刀』って
何に使うんだろうね？
records.current_English:
What do you think
 this Ceremonial Knife was used for?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おい、危ねえな
小刀でも刃物だぜ！？
ちゃんとしまっておけよ
records.current_English:
Hey, careful! A blade's a blade, 
 however small. Put it away before
 you hurt yourself.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん。『太陽紋の鞘』が
ちょうど同じくらいの大きさだし
これに入れておこう…
records.current_English:
All right. The Sun-Crest Sheath
 looks about the right size. I'll 
 put it in there...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
う、うわっ
な、何だ！
すげえ光ってるぞ！
records.current_English: W-whoa! What's that?! It's glowing!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ま、まぶしいっ！
records.current_English: I-it's blinding!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ふう…、もうまぶしくないや
なんだったんだろ、今の光…
records.current_English:
Whew, I can see again. 
 What was that light...?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おい、小刀が落ちてるぜ
records.current_English: Hey, the knife's on the ground.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あ、びっくりして
落としちゃったよ
records.current_English: Oh! The flash made me drop it.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: え…。刃に地図が…
records.current_English:
Huh...? There's a map on 
 the blade...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
こりゃ地図じゃねえか！　きっと
新大陸の『覇者の証』の地図だぜ！
records.current_English:
That's a map! It must show where 
 to find the Proof of Conquest
 in the New World!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そうみたいだね
これで『覇者の証』が手に入るよ！
…でも、不思議だったな…
records.current_English:
I think so too. Now we can find the
 Proof! That was strange, though...

rows: this Ceremonial Knife was used for?

groups.earlier_scene_context: Putting a ceremonialknife inthe matching sun-emblem sheath produces a blindinglight. Rafael drops it;afterwarda map isvisibleonitsblade. Preserve curiosity,alarmandcomicrelief withoutinventing a deity,sacrificeorritualinstruction.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
これは、なかなか面白いですよ
『唐代の竹細工』は、この『竹細工の
組立絵図』のとおりに組み立て
られているんです
records.current_English:
Look at this. The Tang Bamboo Craft
 fits together exactly
 as the Bamboo Assembly Plan shows.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
へえ…、じゃあそれを見ながら
分解したり組み立てたりできるの？
records.current_English:
So we can use the plan to take 
 it apart and put it back together?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
じゃあ、ちょっとやってみましょう
えーと、これが先で…
records.current_English: Let's try. This part comes first...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと待って！
その大きな竹の内側に何か描いてある！
records.current_English:
W-wait! There's something drawn
 inside that big piece of bamboo!

records.speaker: Yifa Sol
records.Japanese:
これをこうしてっと…
で、次はこうかな？
records.current_English: This goes here... then this next?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: なんか楽しそうだね、イファ
records.current_English: Looks like you're having fun, Yifa.

records.speaker: Yifa Sol
records.Japanese:
へへーん
この『唐代の竹細工』って
分解できるんだよ！
records.current_English:
Heh! This Tang Bamboo Craft
 comes apart!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
えっ！
まさか…壊しちゃったの？
records.current_English: What!? Did you break it?

records.speaker: Yifa Sol
records.Japanese:
違うってば！
『竹細工の組立絵図』見てよ！
records.current_English:
No!
 Look at the Bamboo Assembly Plan!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
へえ…なるほどね
この『竹細工の組立絵図』のとおりに
作業すれば、分解も組み立ても
できるんだ
records.current_English:
Oh, I see. The Bamboo Assembly Plan
 shows how to take it apart 
 and put it back together.

records.speaker: Yifa Sol
records.Japanese:
ね、おもしろいよね。…さあて
これで全部を分解したんだよ！
records.current_English: Neat, huh? I took it all apart!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
意外に手先が器用なんだな
あれ？　その竹の裏に何か描いて
あるよ？
records.current_English:
I didn't know you were so good with
 your hands. Wait, there's something
 drawn on the back of that piece.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
何だろう、地図のような…
では、これは東アジアの『覇者の証』の
地図でしょうか！？
records.current_English:
What is that? It looks like
 a map. Could it lead to the
 Proof of Conquest in East Asia?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん。きっとそうだ！
さっそく探しに行こう！
records.current_English: Yes, it must be! Let's go find it!

records.speaker: Yifa Sol
records.Japanese:
わっ！
これ、地図よ！
『覇者の証』の地図なんだわ！
records.current_English:
Whoa! It's a map 
 to the Proof of Conquest!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
すごいや、イファのお手柄だね！
よし、東アジアの『覇者の証』を探しに
いこう！
records.current_English:
Nice work, Yifa! Let's find
 the Proof of Conquest in East Asia!

groups.earlier_scene_context: Two alternative participants disassemble the Tang Bamboo Craft using the Bamboo Assembly Plan. Janus or Yifa discovers a drawing inside/on the back of a bamboo piece. Preserve the Tang cultural context, alternate speakers and their different levels of certainty; approved names and item titles are bound separately.
